intent: A non-modal, searchable inspector dialog for picking an object-animation style (Build in / Action / Build out) from capability-truthful groups, anchored beside the inspector rail.
guidance: Anchor it to the phase's Style control with `trigger`; it portals onto the shared InspectorDialog surface (240px, elevation-400), stays collision-safe within the overlay host, and returns focus to the trigger on close. It is non-modal and never traps focus, so the canvas stays live and Escape / outside-click dismiss. The panel owns the controlled `open` for sibling-dialog exclusivity. Pass only capability-truthful `groups` — supported styles only, no inert design-only rows. Search and category filter reset on every close, so a stale query never survives to the next open. The category-filter row appears only with more than one group. `onSelect` emits the chosen value; the owner applies it and closes.

anatomy.description: 40px title bar with a bottom border: the phase title (body-medium-strong) and the Close X. It is the dialog's drag handle.
40px row with a leading search icon and a text input; filters options by label as you type.
48px row holding an inline dropdown that scopes the list to one group; rendered only when there is more than one group.
Scrollable results region capped at 300px, holding the grouped options with 8px vertical padding.
32px label above each rendered group's options.
32px button: a reserved 16px check slot (filled when the value matches) plus the truncating style label; hover-highlighted.
Centered "No results" shown when the query and category filter match nothing.

use_when: Choosing an object-animation style for a Build in / Action / Build out phase from grouped, searchable options.
The style set is long or categorized enough to need search or category scoping rather than a flat menu.
dont_use_when: A short, flat list of options with no grouping or search — use a Dropdown.
A blocking confirmation or form — use a modal Dialog.

slots.trigger: The Style control the dialog anchors to and launches from; it re-receives focus on dismissal.

tokens.note: No hex literals — every color binds to a c-* token, so tokensOnly holds. Only the header title binds type vars (body-medium-strong); the search, category filter, group headings, options, and empty state use hardcoded type (text-[11px] / leading-[16px] / tracking-[0.055px] / font-[500]|[600]). All dimensions are hardcoded numeric literals (row heights 24/32/40/48px, 240px width, 300px scroll cap, 16px check slot).

a11y.role: dialog (non-modal — aria-modal false; rendered by AnchoredInspectorOverlay with aria-label set to the title, default "Animation styles"). The inspector dialog does not trap focus; Escape / outside-click dismiss and focus returns to the trigger.
a11y.categoryFilter: trigger <button> with aria-haspopup=menu / aria-expanded and aria-label "Filter by category"; the menu is role=menu with role=menuitemradio + aria-checked options.
a11y.options: each option is a <button aria-pressed> reflecting the current selection.

code.example: <AnimationStylesDialog open={open} onClose={close} title="Build in styles" trigger={<Dropdown value={style} />} groups={groups} value={style} onSelect={apply} />
